identity.real_world_identity_notes: The observation is best matched to the base road-going 2000 Ultima GTR: a mid-engine, rear-wheel-drive two-seat coupe with a five-speed manual transmission. This is distinct from the separately named Ultima GTR Race, from the later GTR640 and GTR720 variants, from the open-top Can-Am derivative, and from the later Ultima Evolution.

The checked-out curated dataset contains no existing Ultima record, so this case proposes a new record id.
